name: Racquet Sports Professionals Association
summary: A US-based membership and certification organisation for racket sports teaching professionals, founded in 1927 as the United States Professional Tennis Association (USPTA) and renamed in 2024. It certifies coaches in tennis, pickleball, padel, squash and platform tennis.

founded.text: 1927 (as the United States Professional Tennis Association; renamed RSPA on 17 September 2024)
founded.citation: History & Legacy: The Founding Era and Becoming the RSPA

headquarters.text: 11961 Performance Drive, Orlando, Florida, United States

nameChange.text: Renamed from the United States Professional Tennis Association (USPTA) to the Racquet Sports Professionals Association on 17 September 2024

name: Professional Tennis Registry
summary: An international organisation that educates and certifies tennis coaches through a four-level pathway, founded in 1976. Pickleball and padel certification are run by its sister registries, PPR and PCR.

headquarters.text: 5700 Saddlebrook Way, Wesley Chapel, Florida, United States

name: Professional Pickleball Registry
summary: A pickleball coach education and certification organisation, run as a division of Professional Racquets Registry, Inc, the company behind PTR.

founded.editorNote: No founding year found on pprpickleball.org on 2026-10-25.

headquarters.text: 5700 Saddlebrook Way, Wesley Chapel, Florida, United States

name: Padel Coaches Registry
summary: A membership organisation that certifies padel instructors through workshops and a test, run as a division of Professional Racquets Registry, Inc, the company behind PTR.

name: Professional Platform Tennis Registry
summary: A membership organisation that certifies platform tennis instructors through workshops and a written exam, run as a division of Professional Racquets Registry, Inc, the company behind PTR.

name: International Pickleball Teaching Professional Association
summary: A US non-profit, founded in 2015, that trains and certifies pickleball coaches worldwide at three levels, with a separate junior instructor credential and a player rating programme.

headquarters.editorNote: No address found on iptpa.com home, about or contact pages on 2026-10-25.

name: Global Professional Tennis Coach Association
summary: An international association, founded in 2010 by tour-level coaches, that educates and trains tennis coaches who want to work on the professional tours, and runs ATP-certified courses.

members.text: Represented in 40 countries through national presidents

name: Pickleball Coaching International
summary: An online pickleball coach education and certification organisation founded by coach Mark Renneson, offering Level 1 instructor certification; it is an official partner of USA Pickleball.
